$comment: Proof of WHICH checkout a browser measurement actually measured. This machine holds several worktrees of this site and Playwright's reuseExistingServer means whichever one already owns the port is the one that gets tested; that has already produced a run where a booking fix measured as absent and three pricing tests failed against a tree the runner never touched. Every cinematic guard fetches this file over HTTP first and compares the token. A stranger's server does not have this file (serve.js answers a missing path with index.html), so the parse fails and the guard fails loudly instead of reporting a pass about somebody else's application.
